{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2019}}
{{main|2019 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''men's doubles''' competition of the [[2019 World Table Tennis Championships]] was held from 22 to 27 April 2019.<ref>{{cite web |title=Liebherr 2019 World Table Tennis Championships / Schedule |url=https://www.ittf.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/2019-WTTC_HUN_Schedule_32T.pdf |website=ITTF |accessdate=22 January 2019 |archive-date=19 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190419124530/https://www.ittf.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/2019-WTTC_HUN_Schedule_32T.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> [[Fan Zhendong]] and [[Xu Xin (table tennis)|Xu Xin]] were the defending champions but neither of them competed this year.<ref>{{cite web|title=Entry list|url=https://oes.ittf.com/view/event/entries/e33449f4-4cc0-4383-b6a2-d151aa14e33c/detail|website=ITTF |accessdate=3 April 2019}}</ref>

[[Ma Long (table tennis)|Ma Long]] and [[Wang Chuqin]] won the title after defeating [[Ovidiu Ionescu]] and [[Álvaro Robles (table tennis)|Álvaro Robles]] 11–3, 8–11, 11–7, 11–3, 11–5.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ma Long guides Wang Chuqin to gold|url=https://www.ittf.com/2019/04/27/ma-long-guides-wang-chuqin-gold/|website=ITTF|accessdate=27 April 2019|archive-date=27 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190427135828/https://www.ittf.com/2019/04/27/ma-long-guides-wang-chuqin-gold/|url-status=live}}</ref>
